CURRICULUM VITAE

Tomislav Mesarić
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia | +385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com

PROFESSIONAL PROFILE
Butcher and meat counter professional with 9 years’ experience in retail butchery and meat-counter service. Skilled in breaking down beef, pork and lamb, boning and trimming, portioning meat to order, and advising customers on cuts and cooking. HACCP knowledge and training, with experience rotating cold-room stock using FIFO and maintaining clean, safe counters and equipment.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante, Zagreb | 2019–Present
- Break down 2–3 beef forequarters and 10–12 pork sides each week; bone, trim and cut, portion and wrap fresh meat for the service counter.
- Prepare four kinds of fresh sausage; produce around 40 kg weekly in the busy season.
- Developed the shop’s lamb merguez recipe and adjusted the ćevapi mix to 70% beef and 30% lamb following customer feedback. The ćevapi won second place at the Zagreb County craft meat fair in 2023.
- Record cold-room (0–4 °C) and display-counter temperature checks twice daily; rotate cold-room stock each morning using FIFO, placing the oldest stock at the front.
- Serve around 120 customers on a Saturday, advising on cuts and cooking times.
- Trained two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines.
- Prepared whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting at weddings and family events, including ordering, butchering, seasoning and delivery. Largest order: four lambs and two pigs for a 180-guest wedding in 2024.
- Kept weight-loss and temperature records during a six-week dry-ageing trial of beef ribs.

Counter Assistant | Tržnica Dolac meat hall stall, Zagreb | 2015–2019
- Served customers, weighed and priced orders, operated the till and completed cash-up.
- Cleaned and sanitised slicers, mincers and the counter at closing.
- Wrote a closing and cleaning checklist covering the slicer, mincer, counter and floor drain.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATES
Vocational Certificate: Butcher (3-year programme) | Food Trades School Zagreb | 2015
HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate | 2021; renewed 2024
Preparing for the Master Butcher exam (majstorski ispit), planned for spring 2027

SKILLS
Carcass breakdown (beef, pork and lamb) · Boning and trimming · Portioning meat to order · Fresh sausage making · Knife sharpening · Mincer and bandsaw operation · FIFO stock rotation · Customer advice on cuts and cooking · Counter cleaning and sanitation · Cash handling

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native) · English (good) · German (basic)


COVER LETTER

Tomislav Mesarić
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia
+385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com

Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant position at FreshCart Supermarkets’ Zagreb-Jarun store. I bring nine years of experience in butchery and meat-counter service, along with completed butcher training and HACCP knowledge.

In my current butcher role, I break down beef, pork and lamb, bone and trim cuts, and portion and wrap fresh meat for the counter. I also prepare fresh sausages and advise customers on cuts and cooking times. Previously, at the Dolac market stall, I served customers, weighed and priced orders, operated the till and maintained clean, sanitised equipment and counters. These experiences have given me a strong foundation in both practical meat preparation and friendly, helpful counter service.

I am used to recording temperature checks twice daily and rotating cold-room stock each morning using FIFO. I take care to maintain hygienic work areas and reliable stock routines, and I have trained two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning practices. I would welcome the opportunity to bring this experience and pride in good work to FreshCart’s counter team.

Thank you for considering my application. I would be pleased to discuss how my experience could contribute to the Zagreb-Jarun store.

Kind regards,
Tomislav Mesarić

critique.content_quality_feedback: The actual letter is clear, concise, professional, and relevant to the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant role. It presents strong evidence of practical butchery, customer service, hygiene, temperature-recording, FIFO stock rotation, and apprentice training. However, the document is seriously undermined by including a complete CV before the cover letter and by starting with the heading “CURRICULUM VITAE” even though the document is identified as a cover letter. This makes the submission look incorrectly assembled and much longer than the employer requested. The letter could also be slightly more targeted to FreshCart’s stated priorities, particularly fresh local food, knowledgeable customer advice, reliability, hygiene, and pride in good work.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The cover letter itself uses standard headings, readable text, conventional section order, and relevant searchable terms such as “butchery,” “HACCP,” “FIFO,” “temperature checks,” “portion,” “wrap,” “customer service,” and “sanitised.” These features should parse well. However, placing a full CV before the letter creates substantial duplicated content and may confuse document classification, keyword weighting, and AI screening. The current AI-screening probability is moderate rather than high because the file may be interpreted as an incorrectly formatted CV/cover-letter combination instead of the requested short letter. Removing the duplicated CV should materially improve parsing and document classification.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The letter strongly demonstrates the two must-have requirements: completed butcher training and HACCP knowledge. It also aligns well with the core duties of cutting, portioning and packaging fresh meat for a counter, advising customers on cuts and cooking, recording temperature checks, rotating stock using FIFO, and maintaining hygienic equipment and counters. The tone also supports FreshCart’s culture of friendliness, reliability, hygiene, and pride in good work. The candidate has no forklift licence, which is a genuine nice-to-have gap rather than a document defect. The letter does not claim supermarket, self-service packaging, tray-sealer, or forklift experience, which is appropriately truthful. It could make the FreshCart fit more explicit by connecting the candidate’s customer advice and hygiene routines to the company’s “Ask the counter” service model.
critique.improvement_instructions:
CRITICAL — At the very beginning of the document, remove everything from “CURRICULUM VITAE” through the end of the duplicated CV, including the repeated profile, experience, education, skills, and languages sections. Retain only the actual cover letter beginning with Tomislav Mesarić’s contact details and “Dear Hiring Team,” because the advertisement requests a CV and a short letter as separate documents. Remove the “CURRICULUM VITAE” heading entirely.

MINOR — In the opening paragraph, make the mandatory qualifications more explicit by changing “along with completed butcher training and HACCP knowledge” to “including completed vocational butcher training and HACCP knowledge.” This uses the job advertisement’s terminology more directly and makes both must-have requirements immediately visible to a recruiter or screening system.

MINOR — In the second paragraph, change “portion and wrap fresh meat for the counter” to “cut, portion and package fresh meat for the service counter.” This more closely reflects the employer’s wording while remaining truthful to the candidate’s experience wrapping meat for the counter.

MINOR — In the third paragraph, replace “I would welcome the opportunity to bring this experience and pride in good work to FreshCart’s counter team” with a more specific closing sentence such as: “I would welcome the opportunity to support FreshCart’s Zagreb-Jarun counter with reliable FIFO stock rotation, careful hygiene records, and honest, helpful advice on cuts and cooking.” This connects documented experience to FreshCart’s stated service and culture priorities without adding unsupported experience.
critique.critical_issues: The document is presented as a cover letter but contains a complete duplicated CV before the letter and begins with “CURRICULUM VITAE.” This is a serious document-assembly and professionalism issue that could confuse recruiters and ATS/AI document classification. Remove the duplicated CV and retain only the short cover letter.

In my current butcher role, I break down beef, pork and lamb, bone and trim cuts, and cut, portion and package fresh meat for the service counter. I also prepare fresh sausages and advise customers on cuts and cooking times. Previously, at the Dolac market stall, I served customers, weighed and priced orders, operated the till and maintained clean, sanitised equipment and counters. These experiences have given me a strong foundation in both practical meat preparation and friendly, helpful counter service.

I am used to recording temperature checks twice daily and rotating cold-room stock each morning using FIFO. I take care to maintain hygienic work areas and reliable stock routines, and I have trained two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning practices. I would welcome the opportunity to support FreshCart’s Zagreb-Jarun counter with reliable FIFO stock rotation, careful hygiene records, and honest, helpful advice on cuts and cooking.

Thank you for considering my application. I would be pleased to discuss how my experience could contribute to the Zagreb-Jarun store.

Kind regards,
Tomislav Mesarić

critique.content_quality_feedback: The cover letter is concise, professional, and well targeted to the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant role at the Zagreb-Jarun store. It clearly presents nine years of relevant experience, completed butcher training, HACCP knowledge, meat preparation, customer service, FIFO rotation, temperature checks, hygiene, and apprentice training. The examples are credible and consistent with the candidate information. The letter has a logical progression from application purpose to relevant experience and a professional closing. It could be marginally stronger by naming the HACCP certificate and making the connection to FreshCart's service-counter responsibilities slightly more explicit.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The letter is ATS-friendly: it uses conventional headings and paragraphs, contains no problematic tables, graphics, columns, or unusual formatting, and includes relevant keywords such as butcher, meat-counter service, beef, pork, lamb, bone, trim, portion, package, fresh meat, fresh sausages, customers, temperature checks, FIFO, hygiene, and HACCP. AI screening probability is high because the document is concise, role-specific, and directly mirrors the advertised duties. A minor keyword improvement would be to use the exact phrase 'HACCP knowledge and training' or identify the 'HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate,' and to include 'service counter' in the final paragraph if desired.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The document shows a strong match for the role. It addresses both must-have requirements: completed butcher training and more than two years of meat-counter experience, as well as HACCP knowledge. It also matches the main duties of cutting, portioning, packaging, customer advice, FIFO rotation, temperature checks, hygiene records, and counter cleanliness. The tone fits FreshCart's stated priorities of reliability, hygiene, friendliness, knowledgeable customer advice, and pride in good work. The candidate does not have the nice-to-have forklift licence, which is a genuine gap rather than a document defect. The candidate also has no supermarket experience and has not used tray-sealing or self-service labelling equipment, but these are not listed as mandatory requirements and should not be implied in the letter.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR ENHANCEMENT: In the opening paragraph, change "including completed vocational butcher training and HACCP knowledge" to "including a completed Vocational Certificate in Butchery and a HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate, renewed in 2024." This makes the qualification more specific while remaining fully supported by the candidate information.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT: In the final body paragraph, change "support FreshCart’s Zagreb-Jarun counter with reliable FIFO stock rotation, careful hygiene records, and honest, helpful advice on cuts and cooking" to "support FreshCart’s Zagreb-Jarun service counter with reliable FIFO stock rotation, accurate temperature and hygiene records, and helpful advice on cuts, quantities and cooking." This uses the job advertisement's terminology more closely without claiming unsupported experience.
